entities.name: Kobo
entities.description: Young human apprentice of the ogre shaman Hidetsugu on Kamigawa, formerly a budoka monk.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: Ogre shaman who trained Kobo and avenged his death.

entities.name: Sokenzan
entities.description: Mountain where Kobo sought a yamabushi master.

entities.name: Toshi Umezawa
entities.description: Came to Hidetsugu for help and traveled with Kobo.

entities.name: Myojin of Infinite Rage
entities.description: Kami whose minions Toshi and Kobo defeated.

entities.name: Princess Michiko Konda
entities.description: Princess whose party Toshi and Kobo met.

events.summary: Rejected by the yamabushi, Kobo meets the ogre shaman Hidetsugu and becomes his apprentice.
events.quote: he met the ogre shaman Hidetsugu, who was looking for an apprentice

events.summary: Over five years Kobo endures Hidetsugu's abuse and training in ogre blood and chaos magic.
events.quote: Hidetsugu trained Kobo in the ways of ogre blood and chaos magic

events.summary: Hidetsugu sends Kobo with Toshi Umezawa to Jukai for field experience.
events.quote: He then sent the youth with Toshi, to gain some "field experience".

events.summary: Toshi and Kobo defeat three kami minions of the Myojin of Infinite Rage.
events.quote: defeated three kami minions of the Myojin of Infinite Rage

events.summary: Orochi overwhelm Kobo with numbers and poison, and tie him to trees.
events.quote: he was overwhelmed by their sheer numbers and poison
The wizard Choryu abused the situation to drown Kobo

events.summary: Hidetsugu avenges Kobo by torturing Choryu, destroying Minamo School, attacking Oboro and consuming Mochi.
events.quote: His death was eventually avenged by Hidetsugu who tortured Choryu for months
